qualification: Compatible successful-task guard measured in3pairs; no convincing overall benefit established. Nonblocking replacement remains contract-blocked.
actualTrackingIssueBody:
## Outcome

**No-gain: original source restored, no optimization commit or performance
PR.** One compatible `IsCompletedSuccessfully` guard was measured in three
paired source comparisons. It skips GetResult only for successful completed
template tasks; the pending/failure/cancellation path remains unchanged.
This is not a claim that the guard is contract-blocked or that the original
code has zero cost.

Nonblocking replacement is a separate, incompatible proposal: public
Display/Editor return IHtmlContent synchronously. A Task-returning replacement
breaks compiled binding; returning unfinished content changes output,
exception/cancellation timing and disposal. Those contracts remain unchanged.

## All comparisons

Positive percentages favor the guard; negatives are slower. The two
Display.Default cases are unchanged built-in String-template controls.

| Profile | Pair 1 less time % | Pair 2 less time % | Pair 3 less time % |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Display.Completed32 | 1.36 | -2.37 | 6.22 |
| Display.Completed4096 | 2.93 | 15.24 | 7.57 |
| Editor.Completed32 | 6.86 | 0.31 | -0.45 |
| Editor.Completed4096 | -13.46 | 16.98 | 3.66 |
| Display.Default32, unchanged | 1.86 | 3.02 | -1.68 |
| Display.Default4096, unchanged | 8.93 | -6.57 | -0.76 |

Long custom Display is favorable in all three pairs, with a smallest change
of 2.93%; that evidence is retained. Target regressions/reversals, unchanged
control movement and within-profile CV up to 32.92% prevent a convincing
overall benefit. Allocation observations are not all identical: a 128 B/op
adverse short-case difference, opposing 55 B/op long-Display differences and
1-2 B/op residuals remain. No structural allocation reduction is claimed.

Exactly three comparisons, six timed native profiles, 36 report rows and all
288 raw stdout/JSON samples remain. The timing budget is permanently closed.
Native means, sample variance, SD and SE are independently recomputed.
These are complete prepared helper/template/request-scope/output wrappers,
not isolated awaiter costs, API rankings or application throughput.

## Persistent evidence and actual contracts

[Immutable runnable project, complete paired table and raw evidence](https://github.com/jaslawinMs/aspnetcore/tree/787223221224c0920f49952234b2a2e2a2b2178d/F031).
The independent [source branch](https://github.com/jaslawinMs/aspnetcore/tree/autoperf/F031-template-completed-task)
is restored to unchanged `37e809ead5824bc753a1c3d56f11615bdb1296c5`.
Captured current main matches 21 selected files; all 69 raw source/config
snapshots and bounded work/history/documentation checks remain.

Actual synchronous public Display/Editor invokes TemplateBuilder/TemplateRenderer
and a real RazorView/C# page with its own pending producer, using real scoped
MVC buffers. There is no harness task wait. Before release, the actual template
task is incomplete, calling thread is waiting, public invocation has not
returned, root output is only `before|` and the view is not disposed.

Original, candidate and independently rebuilt relocated images each pass six
completed profiles and 12 additional contracts. They cover mode-specific
FindView fallback, already-faulted/canceled and pending success/failure/cancellation
producers, exact encoded consumed output, exception identity/tokens, actual
child ViewData/model/prefix/additional data, view disposal and restored/open
caller writer. This is not a parent RazorView, HTTP or cshtml compiler test.

Both fresh owning scopes pass 525/525, 0 skipped; all 1,050 actual TRX rows are
parsed. The original wrapper's post-test ordered-dictionary Measure-Object
failure is retained separately from its passing native runner. Corrected
aggregation reverified the same original invocation without rerunning tests.

Measured harness DLL/PDB bytes are identical. Each frozen consumer has 294
files and differs only in the actually tested ViewFeatures DLL/PDB. The live
audit rehashes 1,000 unique files/5,200 bindings, including 882 consumer and
4,242 loaded-assembly bindings. Matching frozen images retain both historical
owners; restored current product bytes match the original. Selected PE/PDB/
source associations are not full compiler provenance or method coverage.

Successful measured/relocated standalone and restored-owner builds report
0 warnings/0 errors. All measured sources/images remain byte-exact. The portable
audit verifies copied text/receipts, not omitted native bytes. Exact commands,
outcomes, failed wrapper and all adverse observations remain in the capsule.

Seventy-two before/after settings observations match. This is a shared Windows
Hyper-V VM; heavy work is serialized, max two build workers, with no priority,
affinity, power or unrelated-process changes. No production-frequency,
request-abort producer, starvation, deadlock, allocation-type or application
speedup claim. No API/baseline/default/visibility/root-package changes remain.
